pages.text: $(o)When you walk into the Portal's courtyard, the Lantern-Bearer will hand you one. Do not lose it: it is the only light the Vault recognizes.$()

Source: the Lantern-Bearer, when you walk into the Portal's courtyard; it can also be found in the Observatory arena chest. Place it on the Vault Altar, in the Watchers' Vault (underground, near Y 0): it will float, light the Vault, and unseal its chests.
